title: Catalog index + mapping (lives in maximall-web; DataTables are never edited)
description: Inputs: (1) UE export D:/AI_Consultant_Workspace/catalog/ue_export/*.json produced by the tech artist's read-only editor Python commandlet from DT_FurnitureCatalog, DT_SharedCountertops, DT_SharedSinks, AllowedFaucetIDs, AllowedMirrorIDs, DT_CabinetSetLayouts; (2) scraped oliveeka.by products (cache D:/AI_Consultant_Workspace/catalog/scrape_cache). Output: maximall-web/data/catalog/index.json = {syncedAt, source, products:[scrapedProduct], mappings:[mapping], unmapped:[...]}. Coverage goal: every (productId, component, sizeIndex, colourIndex) option present in the UE export has exactly one mapping with a price.

articleCode.description: As printed on the site, e.g. MIL80A+CMA80W

productId.description: DT_FurnitureCatalog RowName (for shared components: the owning product row)

sharedId.description: Row name in DT_Shared*/Allowed* for countertop/sink/faucet/mirror

sizeIndex.description: Cabinet/closet: size index. Shared components: model index in the booth-resolved option space of cabinetSizeIndex (CR-AI-01).

colourIndex.description: Cabinet/closet: index into the component's full colour list. Countertop/sink/faucet/mirror: index in the booth-resolved option space (AShowroomBooth::GetResolvedComponentOptions) of cabinetSizeIndex — dangling ids skipped, colours filtered by SizeIndices and re-indexed, faucets split by countertop type (CR-AI-01, QA-007).

match.description: estimated = no scraped product found; price derived from the closest sibling and flagged in the UI/dossier as «цена уточняется». Must be listed in the QA log.

cabinetSizeIndex.description: Shared components: the cabinet size whose resolved option space sizeIndex/colourIndex address

topKind.description: Faucets only: countertop type the faucet list belongs to

unpriced.description: No price source at all; priceBYN=0, excluded from totals, shown as «цена уточняется»
